name: What's for Dinner Tonight?
source:
It's Lyeren's first day at his new job working in a quaint restaurant in his hometown! 

Bussing tables and taking orders is no walk in the park, especially with the keen-eyed chef, Ridae, watching over his shoulder for a mistake.  By coincidence, he reunites with his friendly high school acquaintance, Citta, who might be suspiciously too nice at times! Eek! 

What does those two want from Lyeren? As Lyeren gets slowly embroiled into their stories, he might get more attached than he likes to admit...

[from [url=https://fisheater39.itch.io/whats-for-dinner-tonight]itch.io[/url]]
